sub_fields.label: Layout
sub_fields.name: layout
sub_fields.instructions: Select whether the accordion will float left or right on the page.

sub_fields.label: Tag(s)
sub_fields.name: calendar_tag
sub_fields.instructions: Filter which productions show in this calendar by select one or more tags.

sub_fields.label: Column Number
sub_fields.name: column_number
sub_fields.instructions: Choose the number of columns per row. For example, if you have 10 blocks, you most likely will want 5 columns per row.

sub_fields.label: Graphic Type
sub_fields.name: graphic_type
sub_fields.instructions: Choose whether you will have an icon/logo or a photo.

sub_fields.label: Button Text
sub_fields.name: button_text
sub_fields.instructions: If this field is filled out, the link will appear as a button. If not, the entire column will link.

sub_fields.message: NOTE: In order for the Instagram feed to appear, you must connect your account in the 'Instagram Feed' tab in the menu on the left.

sub_fields.label: Feed Number
sub_fields.name: instagram_feed_num
sub_fields.instructions: Go to Instagram Feed > All Feeds and locate the feed number in the shortcode (e.g., feed="1").

sub_fields.label: Image
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: To add or edit the caption, click the image here or go through the Media Library.

sub_fields.label: Post Type
sub_fields.name: post_type
sub_fields.instructions: Choose whether you want to display the latest posts or display posts according to category

sub_fields.label: View Option
sub_fields.name: view_option
sub_fields.instructions: NOTE: When using "Show All Productions" or "Show Productions with Tag", productions are ordered by their Start Date (set on the production edit page).

sub_fields.label: Productions Option
sub_fields.name: productions_option
sub_fields.instructions: The "Only show upcoming" option will pull productions in based on the Production End Date field set in the General tab on the Production pages.
